dct_description_sm: The Department of Public Works and Services maintains over 750 Government of Northwest Territories assets including school, hospitals, offices, correctional facilities and many community assets. With climatic change, the design parameters for infrastructure in the north have changed to address the impacts of global warming and among the important issues associated with climate change are the changes to structures and foundations with regards to both the weight of the snow on a roof and the active layer of the permafrost on wooden piles. In Inuvik, there have already been a high school roof failure and two foundation failures. This project aimed to evaluate the structural integrity of public buildings, in order to determine the risk of roof and foundation failure as a result of climatic conditions. The project also developed adaptation strategies and determine the economic cost of changing climatic conditions on the foundations and roofs evaluated.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Risk Evaluation of Government Buildings in NWT Communities to Changing Climatic Conditions
